At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Ripple is expanding its Business Development team in North America and hiring a Business Development Senior Manager to originate, structure, and close partnerships across Ripple’s businesses: Payments, Custody, RLUSD, RippleX, Ripple Prime, and Ripple Treasury.

Specifically, you will own business development efforts for XRP Credit & Yield, Ripple’s initiative to build institutional-grade credit and yield markets for XRP and RLUSD, primarily on the XRP Ledger. You will expand the partner book of lending protocols, vault curators, credit platforms, market makers and institutional lenders and borrowers.

Based in New York or San Francisco, you will work closely with RippleX, Ripple Prime, Ripple Treasury, Risk and Finance. This is an externally facing role for someone who is credible and experienced across both DeFi and TradFi markets.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Originate, structure and close partnerships across Ripple’s product suite with banks, fintechs, payment providers, asset managers, trading firms, crypto-native platforms and DeFi protocols
  • Identify deals that span more than one product line, build the internal business case, and collaborate across the Ripple Payments, RLUSD, RippleX, Ripple Prime and Ripple Treasury teams to form meaningful partnerships
  • Own business development for XRP Credit & Yield: build and manage the pipeline of DeFi lending protocols, vault curators, credit platforms and institutional counterparties that expands XRP-collateralized lending, RLUSD liquidity, and yield on the XRP Ledger and beyond.
  • Structure credit and yield partnerships end to end, including collateral terms, risk parameters, liquidity commitments and partner incentives, and size Ripple’s capital and incentive commitments against clear targets with Risk, Treasury and Finance
  • Partner across RippleX and Ripple Prime to connect on-chain credit and yield with institutional financing, prime brokerage and collateral workflows
  • Track rates, deal structures, and competitors across DeFi credit and institutional lending markets, and bring those insights into Ripple’s strategy and positioning

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 8+ years of experience across business development, strategic partnerships, investment banking or capital markets, including meaningful time in digital assets or DeFi
  • Working knowledge across multiple Ripple verticals, including: payments, stablecoin, custody, tokenization and institutional trading, and the curiosity to go deep on each
  • Hands-on DeFi credit experience, ideally at a leading on-chain lending or institutional credit protocol, with a working command of lending markets, vaults, collateral and liquidation mechanics, interest rate models and sources of yield
  • A traditional finance or defi-native foundation, with strong financial modeling, deal structuring, and execution ability
  • Proven ability to source, structure and close complex, multi-party commercial agreements with measurable revenue or strategic outcomes
  • An established network across DeFi protocols, crypto-native lenders, trading firms and financial institutions that you can mobilize from day one
  • Strong judgment, an ownership mindset and comfort building without an existing playbook
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with experience presenting to senior executives internally and externally
  • Fluency with both AI and standard tools of the trade (Claude, Gemini, Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, Power BI, etc.)
  • A Bachelor’s degree is required, and an MBA or equivalent is helpful
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions. 
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$212,000—$255,000 USD

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.

  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support

Take Care of Yourself

  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

descriptions.job-13qffxb:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our team partners with Stripe’s Chief Business Officer and leaders across Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product. Global Partnerships builds and manages relationships with banks, networks, payment methods, and other strategic partners that enable Stripe’s products and global expansion. The Startup and Ecosystem Product teams build tools and capabilities that help founders start and grow businesses and partners to extend Stripe products to better serve users across our entire ecosystem, respectively.

The Finance & Strategy team brings financial rigor, strategic clarity, and analytical depth to the decisions that shape Stripe’s business and long-term growth strategy. We act as a strategic finance function for complex commercial partner negotiations and work with product leaders to shape their strategy, growth, investment priorities, and financial performance as it scales. We help leaders evaluate partner economics, allocate resources, establish goals, and understand performance in order to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a finance leader to lead Finance & Strategy for Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product. You’ll serve as a trusted financial and strategic advisor to the Chief Business Officer and other senior business leaders, connecting commercial decisions to their financial implications.

You’ll lead a team of strategic finance professionals to craft deal analysis and structure recommendations, investment frameworks, and strategic insights that drive long-term economic growth for Stripe. In addition, you will work cross-functionally to ensure disciplined financial planning and forecasting. You’ll develop the team, establish clear priorities, and balance time-sensitive deal support with recurring financial commitments and targeted strategic analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the financial evaluation of complex product enablement partnerships. Partner with Global Partnerships leaders and Partner Development Managers to evaluate and execute commercial agreements with new and existing partners, bringing an independent financial perspective to negotiation strategy and decisions.
  • Guide deal economics and investment analysis. Oversee financial modeling, commercial benchmarking, scenario analysis, and investment cases. Translate complex deal structures into clear assessments of financial impact, risks, returns, and commercial trade-offs.
  • Improve partner economics and performance visibility. Develop data-driven insights to identify strategic and optimization opportunities for Stripe’s partner portfolio. Establish consistent frameworks and metrics to assess partner initiatives and deals.
  • Build investment cases in support of new business initiatives. Craft financial models in support of Startup and Ecosystem Product initiatives and establish objectives and metrics in partnership with Business and Product leaders.
  • Actively contribute to org building as part of the F&S leadership team. Help shape and execute F&S priorities, influence and drive cross-functional initiatives, and contribute to culture building of the organization.
  • Coordinate cross-functional financial recommendations. Work closely with Product and Engineering, Pricing, Strategy and Operations, Treasury Finance, Accounting, and other Finance & Strategy teams to support planning and forecasting activities.
  • Own the financial planning and forecasting cycle. Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and business reviews for Global Partnerships and Startup and Ecosystem Product areas.
  • Guide operating expense management. Maintain visibility into resource plans, assess investment and efficiency trade-offs, and surface material changes that require leadership decisions.
  • Partner on goals, metrics, and performance. Help leaders establish financial objectives and key business metrics for priority businesses and initiatives. Explain material deviations from plan, identify underlying drivers, and recommend actions.
  • Build and develop a high-performing team. Coach and develop direct reports, set clear expectations, and maintain high standards for analytical quality, business partnership, and execution.
  • Scale the team’s effectiveness. Improve financial models, reporting, planning processes, and analytical infrastructure. Use AI, automation, and better tooling to reduce manual work and create capacity for higher-value analysis.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years in strategic finance, commercial finance, product finance, or FP&A, with demonstrated success leading and developing finance teams.
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience evaluating complex partnership agreements, building investment cases, and supporting negotiations through rigorous financial analysis.
  • Strong grounding in budgeting, forecasting, headcount and operating expense planning, and business performance management.
  • A proven ability to build trusted relationships with executives and cross-functional leaders, provide an objective perspective, and influence consequential decisions.
  • Exceptional analytical and financial modeling capabilities, with the ability to connect detailed economics to broader business strategy.
  • A hands-on leadership style and the judgment to prioritize across urgent transactions, recurring operating commitments, and longer-term strategic work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting complex financial information and recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, a working knowledge of SQL, and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience at a high-growth payments company, fintech, or bank
  • Deep understanding of payments unit economics, including card networks, banks, and the role of partnerships in enabling financial products.
  • Prior experience in investment banking, private equity, or another transaction-oriented analytical role.
  • Experience using AI, automation, and financial planning or analytics tools to improve the quality and scalability of finance work.
descriptions.job-17brucf:
Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

About the role
Do you know where the best specialized talent actually lives, and how to reach them before they ever look for a job? We're looking for a Principal, Talent Acquisition to handle market mapping, research and talent sourcing for Hut 8's most critical growth functions. The value of this role is created long before a hiring need reaches your desk.

This is not a queue of reqs to clear. You will research the talent landscape, map the companies and people that matter, build a proactive pipeline, and design each search strategy from the ground up. You will give our Talent Acquisition (TA) Partners and hiring leaders a clear view of who is out there and what it takes to win them.

You will be a trusted member of our TA team, translating business priorities into sourcing strategies, bringing market evidence to every conversation on scope, timing and compensation. You will own research and sourcing first and, as you earn credibility and trust, take on full-lifecycle searches of your own. We expect you to bring a point of view on how Hut 8 competes for niche talent.
 
What You'll Own
  • Market mapping. Build and maintain talent maps by function, organization or segment. Know the target companies, the org structures, the key individuals and where the real depth of talent sits.
  • Market research and intelligence. Produce a market brief for every search covering supply, likely motivators, competitor activity, compensation benchmarks and relevant constraints. Keep a running view of talent availability, competitor hiring and org moves. Use it to equip TA Partners to challenge assumptions on scope, timing and pay when the market says otherwise, and share regular, decision-ready insight with leadership.
  • Proactive sourcing. Find the people who don't apply. Bring creative approaches to identify top talent, build personalized outreach that earns engagement, and give every candidate an excellent experience.
  • A live talent network. Build and maintain relationships with specialized energy talent and industry connectors year-round, not only when a role is open. Keep tiered, current pipelines for our most critical future hires.
  • Partnership. Turn each search into a clear sourcing strategy, flag talent constraints early, and run multiple niche searches at once with the rigor, quality and urgency they require.
  • Earned ownership. Take on select full-lifecycle requisitions as you build credibility with TA Partners and hiring managers, and grow your scope and ownership over time.
What We're Looking For
You've built talent maps and pipelines for specialized roles, and you know the difference between posting a job and actually finding the people who don't apply. You've worked directly with senior stakeholders and know how to push back with evidence, not just execute. You're comfortable building from scratch in a company that moves fast.
  • Experience in executive search, talent sourcing or talent intelligence for specialized or senior roles, at a search firm or in-house.
  • You have a proven track record of market mapping and research: building target company lists, org charts and talent maps, and turning them into search strategy and hires.
  • You are a hunter. You know where top talent lives, what motivates them, and how to engage them before they're looking.
  • You apply advanced, data-informed sourcing methods to find talent others miss, and you keep improving how we find it.
  • You communicate with precision regardless of audience. You are able to partner with senior leaders, push back on unrealistic requirements, and keep their trust. You know how to earn credibility and ownership over time.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and you're energized by ambiguity rather than slowed by it.

Work setting

This role is based onsite five days a week at our corporate headquarters in the Brickell area of Miami, Florida. Candidates must be Miami-based or willing to relocate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
descriptions.job-1mayc2n:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes.

Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization.

What you'll do

As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations within your cohort's day-to-day work by deeply understanding their processes and outputs
  • Build custom tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to each marketer's specific responsibilities
  • Coach and partner with each marketer through a progressive journey — from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation, to self-sufficiency
  • Teach marketers to build and iterate on their own tools over time, creating independence
  • Recognize patterns across your cohort and systematically scale what works — a tool built for one marketer will be reusable for their peers
  • Document every tool, playbook, and transformation pattern you build so the entire FDA team uses each other's work
  • Share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership to build momentum, inspire, and celebrate success
  • Track individual and cohort progress rigorously against a defined maturity model, moving every marketer toward self-sustaining, AI-first work
  • Prepare marketers for an agentic future — not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows

Who you are

We're looking for people who have already lived the transformation they'll be driving for others. You've used AI to fundamentally change how work gets done, not as a novelty, but as your default operating mode.

  • You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You don't just know what AI can do in theory. You've built things that changed how real teams operate, and the people you built for actually use what you shipped. You build in real time alongside the people you support.
  • You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new programs become viable that weren't worth doing before. Then you build the thing, not just the slide.
  • You understand marketing work. You either have direct experience in marketing or quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of your assigned cohort. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it.
  • You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions.
  • You are a strong communicator. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, adapt your style to different people, and make progress visible to leadership and stakeholders.
  • You are high-caliber, persistent, and versatile. Your skills and experience are valuable across the company. You're the kind of person who succeeds in many roles at Stripe.
  • You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in a role requiring diagnostic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered agents, tools, automations, or workflows that real people use in their actual work, whether that made existing processes meaningfully more efficient or made previously unviable work possible for the first time
  • Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, API integrations, workflow automation tools)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners
  • Comfort working across multiple workstreams and relationships simultaneously (you'll be supporting 25–45 marketers at varying stages of their AI journey)
  • Track record of coaching, teaching, or enabling others, with evidence that people you've helped actually changed how they work

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a formal AI transformation role where the job was substantially about identifying opportunities for workflow transformation and executing on them with hands-on builds
  • Experience helping people become more expert AI users and capable builders
  • Experience in marketing, marketing operations, growth, or a closely adjacent function, including familiarity with marketing technology stacks (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce, analytics platforms, content management tools)

descriptions.job-02h3u3j:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions, including our AI investigations platform Ardence, that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime and global security threats. At TRM, you'll join a mission-driven, fast-paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily.

As an AI Scientist on our new AI Research team, you will build the models and agents behind the intelligence that powers TRM's products. Part of that is training foundation models on blockchain data, one of our most differentiated data layers, and part is building autonomous AI agents that generate intelligence at a scale hand-built heuristics cannot reach. You'll work on Intel Cortex and other ambitious, cross-cutting ideas, with a broad view across intelligence rather than a single risk category. This is pioneering work that does not exist elsewhere in our industry, and it directly drives customer outcomes, from seizing illicit funds to disrupting criminal networks.

The impact you'll have here:

  • Train ML models on blockchain data, including foundation models, and take them from research to production.

  • Build AI agents (and fine-tune LLMs where it helps) so the intelligence underneath TRM's products is generated by models and agents, not only hand-built heuristics.

  • Find new ways to generate net new intelligence, using patterns across all intelligence layers (Network / On-chain / Protocol) that competitors can't replicate.

  • Ship production-quality code: ML models, agents and data pipelines, with rigorous evaluation and scalable architecture.

  • Take on ambitious, high-impact bets that raise the ceiling of what our intelligence can do, and drive measurable outcomes: billions in illicit funds traced, seized, or prevented.

What we’re looking for:

  • Quantitative background (Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics). Advanced degree or equivalent research experience is a plus.

  • Strong machine learning foundations, built over years of applied ML and/or research (modeling, evaluation, experimentation). You don't need to have trained a foundation model or built agents before, but you need the fundamentals to do it.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset: gets to the root cause, leverages creativity, and thrives in ambiguity with a hypothesis-driven, iterative approach.

  • 5+ years of hands-on machine learning experience, with strong Python, SQL, and AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code).

  • Experience with distributed data systems (Spark, BigQuery, Airflow) and shipping production ML code.

  • Strong async communication (Loom, Slack, Notion), strong technical communication in English, and ability to own work independently in a remote environment.

  • Bonus: experience with LLMs, AI agents or fine-tuning; domain curiosity or prior work in blockchain, crypto, fraud, money laundering or financial crime.

About the Team:

  • AI Research is a new team focused on ambitious, cross-cutting ideas in attribution and intelligence.

  • Fully remote and globally distributed. Most overlap occurs 7am–12pm PST for meetings and collaboration.

  • All team members must have at least 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

  • You'll work in partnership with the category pods, whose expert-built heuristics provide the high-confidence labels our models learn from.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid Customer Impact. Deliver last-minute, high-stakes projects for key customers — turning around attribution insights in days, not weeks.

  • MVP to Production. Build complex algorithms with tight timeframes (1-2 sprints for MVP) and iterate based on real customer feedback.

  • Parallel Execution. Juggle multiple priorities across categories and stakeholders while maintaining quality and speed.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. We’re looking for a Full Stack Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to join our Knowledge Layer team, a group focused on extracting, structuring, and analyzing knowledge from large-scale, unstructured data. This team sits at the intersection of knowledge graphs, entity resolution, graph extraction, and graph analytics, and plays a critical role in powering TRM’s core intelligence products.

While the team has strong backend and graph engineering expertise, we are looking for someone to be the machine learning and data science voice in the room — bringing practical ML expertise, especially in knowledge extraction and graph-based ML, to help accelerate and scale our capabilities.

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys operating end-to-end: from model selection and experimentation, to productionizing ML systems and APIs.

  • Design, build, and productionize machine learning models focused on:

    • Knowledge extraction from unstructured data (e.g., NER, entity linking)

    • Graph-based learning and inference

    • Entity resolution and relationship discovery

  • Evaluate and leverage existing ML models and frameworks to solve real-world problems efficiently

  • Partner closely with backend and graph engineers to integrate ML models into production services and APIs

  • Contribute to the design and evolution of knowledge graphs and ontologies

  • Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to inform modeling decisions and system design

  • Own ML components end-to-end, including experimentation, evaluation, deployment, and iteration

  • Help shape best practices for applied ML within the Knowledge Layer team

  • Strong programming experience in Python

  • Hands-on experience building, training, or deploying machine learning models in production

  • Familiarity with NLP or information extraction techniques, such as Named Entity Recognition (NER), text classification, or embedding-based approaches

  • Experience or strong interest in knowledge graphs, graph data, or graph-based ML

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

“If I had asked people what they wanted, they would have said faster horses.”

  • Henry Ford… Or possibly cruise ship designer John McNeece musing about Ford’s customers for a 1999 article published in “The Cruise Industry News Quarterly.”

Either way, the idea is entirely valid. Prospects and customers can have a really great understanding of their pain points (we’re going too slow) without being able to imagine a perfect solution (this horse should go much faster).

Arca is hiring our first Product Marketing Manager to help solve these critical problems: deeply understanding our clients, communicating our solutions, and building a brand that resonates.

The role

You’ll shape how people understand Arca and why they choose us. This is an individual contributor role on our Growth Marketing team for someone who can turn deep customer understanding into clear segmentation, sharp positioning, and messaging that works everywhere a prospect or client meets us: an ad, a nurture email, a seminar, an advisor’s proposal, or a friend’s recommendation.

Most of the role is core product marketing: segmentation, personas, positioning, competitive context, advisor enablement, and launches. You’ll also work on customer marketing: helping our clients’ experiences become the stories, testimonials, reviews, and referrals that bring the next client to us. You’ll report to our Head of Growth and work closely with advisors, our product and engineering teams, design, and compliance.

What you’ll do

Define who we serve and why they choose us

  • Develop and maintain Arca’s segmentation and persona model, covering life stage, financial situation, and the moments that bring someone to an advisor, such as retirement, a liquidity event, or the sale of a business.

  • Build positioning and messaging by segment, grounded in pain points, buying cycles, and competitive context.

  • Make the value of advice tangible. Help prospects see what a fee-only fiduciary does across investments, taxes, estate, and planning, beyond portfolio returns.

  • Maintain a thorough view of the competitive landscape, including direct and non-traditional competitors.

Equip our advisors

  • Build, review, and supplement the materials advisors use with prospects: pitch narratives, proposal frameworks, one-pagers, objection handling, and competitive guides.

  • Spend time with advisors, listen to client conversations, and bring what you learn back into our positioning, marketing, and product plans.

Turn client experiences into growth

  • Build and run Arca’s client story, testimonial, and review programs, in close partnership with advisors and compliance.

  • Steer the system that makes referrals easy for clients and advisors. Advisors maintain great relationships with our clients; we want to make referrals simple and natural.

  • Provide input on client appreciation and client events.

Shape the client journey

  • Partner with our product and engineering teams on the messaging across the lead and client lifecycle: first inquiry, nurture, booking, onboarding, and beyond.

  • Help design and test what moves people to their next step, from the content of a nurture sequence to how we follow up after a first meeting.

  • Measure messaging and programs by their effect on qualified prospects and new clients, not opens and clicks.

  • Bring the voice of the client into product decisions.

Launch what we build

  • Lead go-to-market for client-facing product launches.

  • Keep messaging consistent across the website, paid media, email, direct mail, and advisor materials.

  • Work closely with compliance on positioning, testimonials, and referrals, starting at the brief stage.

About Arca

Arca is a wealth management firm built from the ground up with AI. Most people get financial advice that's reactive: an annual check-in, a plan that's a document instead of a living thing, a relationship where you're one of three hundred clients your advisor is trying to remember. We think that's backwards. The kind of service that used to require a team of specialists behind you, the kind that makes you feel like the only person in the room, should be available to far more than the ultra-wealthy.

So we're building it. We're not SaaS — we are the wealth management business, rebuilding it from the inside with AI. Our platform is an Iron Man suit for advisors: it takes over the low-leverage work so they can focus on what actually requires a human, showing up with empathy, context, and judgment. Underneath, it keeps a living understanding of each client. It remembers the thing you mentioned once, six months ago. It notices when your life changes — a new job, a new kid, a market shift — and adjusts before you think to ask. You won't see the technology. You'll just notice your advisor seems to know you better than any financial professional ever has.

That's the product we're growing: client by client, on the strength of the experience itself. We started by acquiring firms managing over $1B in client assets, which gave us real advisors, real clients, and real financial outcomes to build against from day one. But acquisition was the starting line. The bet is that an advisor backed by this platform delivers something good enough that clients come to us on their own.

It's a $20T market, and we think it's ready to be rebuilt.

— Rron, CEO

The receipts

  • Stage: Series A, $64M raised

  • Backed by: General Catalyst, Index Ventures, Venrock

  • Board & Advisors: Former CEO of Vanguard, Former CFO of Schwab, Founder of Altruist, Morgan Housel (author of The Psychology of Money)

The team

We're small on purpose and engineering heavy: about 80% of the team is technical. We're based in NYC and hail from high growth startups like Stripe, Ramp, Rippling, Plaid, DoorDash, Glean, and Mercury.

Most of the team is fully in-office. We prefer candidates based in New York City, but we’ll consider remote candidates in the US if the fit is right. Remote team members, including this role’s direct manager, spend about one week per month on-site.

Example problems you’d work on

These aren’t hypothetical. We’re working on versions of all of them now.

  • Persona model. Our current personas mix life-stage segments with persona types, and teams use them inconsistently. Decide which dimension leads, build one model the whole company uses, and make it practical for advisors, growth, and product.

  • Who first. Our current clients tell us who Arca serves today. We also need to decide which audiences to prioritize next. Doing everything for everyone means doing nothing well, so this is a real choice with real trade-offs.

  • Value beyond returns. Many people judge an advisor by investment performance alone. Making the value of tax, estate, and planning coordination concrete, and doing it within the rules that govern our marketing, is one of our most challenging messaging problems.

  • The long consideration. Many prospects aren’t ready after a first conversation. Some take months, and some take years. Deciding what we say in that time, when we say it, and how it adapts to each person is how a lead eventually becomes a client.

  • Proof people trust. Prospects check reviews and ask people they know before they book. We need to build testimonial, review, and referral programs that clients are glad to join, advisors are comfortable with, and compliance can approve.

  • One firm, many first impressions. People meet Arca through a search ad, a mailer, a seminar, an advisor, or a friend. Making all of those feel like the same firm, while each speaks to its audience, takes a clear message and a lot of follow-through.

What you bring

Mindset

  • You’d rather spend an afternoon listening to client calls than in a messaging workshop.

  • You can tell the difference between a message people agree with and one they remember.

  • You see compliance constraints as part of the craft, not a hurdle.

  • You judge your work by the pipeline it drives and the new clients it delivers.

Experience

  • 5–8 years of experience, with 3+ in product marketing.

  • Product marketing experience with consumer audiences. Experience with high-consideration purchases is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ownership of positioning and messaging for a product or segment, beyond launch coordination.

  • Hands-on customer research: interviews, message testing, and win-loss analysis.

  • Experience building enablement for sales teams, advisors, or other customer-facing roles.

Skills

  • Clear writing that makes complex financial ideas simple without talking down to anyone.

  • Strong research instincts and comfort working with data.

  • The credibility to work with advisors who have been doing this for decades, and to earn their trust.

  • Working knowledge of lifecycle and nurture marketing.

Bonus

  • Experience in wealth management, financial services, or fintech.

  • A brand background, or experience shaping a company’s brand identity.

  • Customer marketing experience: testimonials, reviews, case studies, or referral programs.

Why this role matters

People don’t choose a financial advisor the way they choose most products. They take their time, ask people they trust, and want to feel confident before handing over the savings of a lifetime. How clearly we explain who we are, and how credibly our clients speak for us, decides whether they ever want to have a first conversation.

Arca grows through paid channels, seminars, referrals, and advisor relationships. Each of those depends on knowing exactly who we serve and what we say to them. This role builds that foundation, and the rest of marketing builds on it.

What kind of person thrives here

You’re excited by ownership, ambiguity, and building things that matter.

  • You hold a high bar because of what’s at stake. This is people’s real money: their retirement, their savings, and the plans they have for their families, in a highly regulated industry. “Good enough” means something different here.

  • You’re AI-pilled and at home with engineers. About 80% of Arca is technical, and AI runs through how we work, marketing included. You use AI tools every day, you’d rather build a prototype or analyze a stack of call transcripts yourself than wait in a queue, and you can talk to engineers in their language.

  • You want to build. We just came out of stealth, and much of how Arca goes to market is being decided right now. You’re comfortable making calls with incomplete information, putting a point of view on the table, and changing it when the evidence says so.

  • You’re someone people actually want to be in the room with. This is a small, tight-knit team that does its best work together, whether you’re in Flatiron every day or for a week each month. Kind, direct, and low-ego, you can give candid feedback without being a jerk, and you’re energized by this environment, not just tolerant of it.
